name: Asian & Island Percussion
subtitle: Hourglass, Bronze & Log Drums
shortDescription: 11 drums and percussion of Asia and the Pacific to play: Janggu, Kakko, Kendang and Dong Son bronze drum.
longDescription:
Asian & Island Percussion: 11 drums and percussion of Asia and the Pacific from 9 countries, in one app that works fully offline.

Inside: Janggu, Kakko, Kendang, Dong Son bronze drum, Dabakan, Tavil, Garamut, Lali, Kundu, Lagerphone and Stamping tubes.

Each one has a short note on where it comes from and how it is played in the real world. You can strike hourglass, bronze, barrel and log drums, bamboo tubes and a bottle-cap pole from Korea, Japan, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, India, Papua New Guinea, Fiji and Australia, learn by watching a demonstration, and read the rules at any time.

No account needed. Works offline.
monetization: Free with ads, optional monthly ad-free
